title: Price houses honestly
brief: Split, standardise, fit by QR, sweep ridge with one SVD, select columns with FISTA lasso, and fit a Newton logistic model for sells-in-30-days.
hints: Fit the scaler on the training rows only, then apply the same mean and std to the validation and test rows. Never call fit_scaler on the full matrix.
After standardising, the training columns have mean 0, so centre the price with the training mean and fit with no intercept column for the regression models.
ridge_path needs one SVD: c = U.T @ y, then each lambda gives w = V @ (s / (s**2 + lam) * c). Stack the rows for all lambdas with broadcasting.
lambda_max is the largest absolute entry of X.T @ y. At that lambda the lasso answer is all zeros, so use a fraction of it.
For the classifier, add an intercept column with add_intercept, fit on the training rows, and compare the test log loss with a predictor that always says the training sell rate.
